# Manuscript

> Manuscript is a statically typed language for native programs, with named arguments, mutable data, explicit errors and scoped resources.

Links are relative to this file so GitHub Pages project paths and custom domains work alike.

## Read in order
- [Get started](learn/getting-started/): a complete application and CLI commands
- [Language tour](learn/tour/): functions, data, and expected failures
- [Language](core-language/): basics, functions, types, control flow, errors, modules, and resources
- [Standard library API reference](standard-library/reference/): generated declarations and import paths
- [Developer tools](developer-tooling/): commands, projects, source tools, and debugging

## Look up a declaration
- [Entire standard library as Markdown](stdlib.md): every standard module, intrinsic prelude, generic bound, field, case, and operation
- [Standard library JSON](stdlib.json): versioned structured declaration snapshot
- [Glossary](glossary/): language terminology

## Contribute
- [Contributor documentation](contributing/): architecture, development checks, compiler internals, and releases
